The galbi pho broth was rich and clean, and the moment I took a sip, it felt like my stomach was soothed. The ribs were also cooked so tenderly that it was enjoyable to eat the meat.
The spring rolls were crispy on the outside and full on the inside, and the combination with the pho was perfect.
The staff were friendly and the food came out quickly, so I had a comfortable meal.
It's a place I want to go to again during my trip to Da Nang because the satisfaction is high for the price. Highly recommend!
